patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I built a sick dirt jump in the woods. Turns out I built it directly in a poison ivy patch. My legs now look like a topographic map and I have not stopped scratching since third period.
presentation.triageNote: 15-year-old male, itchy streaky rash on both shins and forearms two days after building trails in the woods, no facial or airway involvement.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 / Non-Urgent is appropriate because this localized stable rash is expected to need examination and simple treatment without a countable emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is a localized itchy rash after plant exposure without facial, airway, or systemic involvement.
clinical.acuityReason: The patient is comfortable and stable, with no breathing difficulty, facial swelling, fever, severe pain, or widespread systemic findings.
expectedResources: Clinical skin examination and simple medication treatment
keyFindings: Itchy streaky rash on both shins and forearms
teachingPoints: Linear or streaky dermatitis after outdoor exposure supports a contact pattern.
Facial, ocular, airway, extensive, or infected involvement would change the urgency and treatment needs.

possibleDiagnoses: Allergic contact dermatitis from poison ivy or another plant
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would likely receive topical or short-course systemic treatment when indicated, exposure-removal advice, and discharge precautions.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 15-year-old boy in muddy bike shorts, helmet beside him
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, one leg up, fighting the urge to scratch
aiImageGeneration.expression: annoyed and itchy, a little embarrassed
signs: streaky red blistered rash down both shins
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 15-year-old boy in muddy bike shorts with a helmet beside him, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting, one leg up, fighting the urge to scratch. Expression: annoyed and itchy, a little embarrassed. Clearly visible: streaky red blistered rash down both shins, caught mid-scratch. Overall miserable but totally stable. No text, no logos.
